name: Name
remove_body: Requests that use it will send the reference unresolved.
delete_body: Its secrets are kept on this device only, so they cannot be recovered.
delete_linked_body: The vault is removed from the workspace. Its secrets stay in the provider.
revert_title: Revert “{name}” to the last synced version?
revert_body: Changes to its source since then are discarded.
state_sealed_hint: Enter the passphrase to use or edit its secrets.
state_linked_sealed_hint: Unseal to pull its secrets from {provider}.
state_unapproved_hint: Review where its secrets are pulled from before using it here.
state_unsealed_hint: Unsealed: its secrets resolve in requests.
seal_tooltip: Forget the values; they are pulled again when it is unsealed
check_tooltip: Pull its source once and count the secrets, without showing a value
add_secret_tooltip: Add a secret to this vault
no_secrets_body: Add one, then use it in a request as {{vault.NAME}}.
usage: To run a program with these as environment variables:  bifurc vault run {name} -- <command>
local_footer: Kept on this device only. Not synced.
moved_title: This vault is now kept on this device only
moved_body: Earlier versions synced it, encrypted, with the workspace. It was taken out of the repository, but its old copies stay in the repository's history. If someone who knew its passphrase should no longer have these secrets, change them where they were issued.
unapproved_title: Not set up on this device
unapproved_body: This vault came with the workspace, or a sync changed its {provider} source. Review it before its secrets are pulled here.
no_vault_body: A vault keeps secrets out of the workspace: on this device, or in a secret manager such as 1Password or AWS Secrets Manager.
title: Vaults
description: Secrets that requests use as {{vault.NAME}}. No value is synced: a vault keeps them on this device, or reads them from a secret manager.
pulled_hint: Pulled from {provider}. Change its secrets there.
no_pulled_body: Unseal it to pull its secrets from {provider}, then use them in a request as {{vault.NAME}}.
beta_body: Vaults are unstable and still under development. They may not work as expected, and how they store data may change. Local vaults stay on this device only: they are never synced or committed to git. Keep your own copy of any secret you store here.
